text: SELECT session_user::pg_catalog.text AS original_actor,current_user::pg_catalog.text AS effective_actor,(SELECT rolsuper::pg_catalog.text FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) session_user) AS native_superuser,(SELECT rolbypassrls::pg_catalog.text FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) session_user) AS native_bypass,pg_catalog.current_setting('client_encoding')::pg_catalog.text AS native_encoding
